description: Serves a floor plan asset file for the given plan ID and filename. Requires the same session authentication as other integration endpoints.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/innerspace/integration/v1/assets/{planId}/{filename}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Download plan asset file
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.innerspace:
    path: "/v1/assets/{planId}/{filename}"
    method: GET
  register: result

- debug:
    var: result.data
